plays.description: Takes a knee on the opening kickoff.
Steps up and is sacked; commentary credits Noel Williams.
Replay describes Nix moving off a doubled Waddle and throwing an interception to M. Delane on a deep middle pass intended for Courtland Sutton. Delane returns it 5 yards.
plays.coverage_scheme: Underneath coverage with help over the top; Waddle doubled

plays.description: Handoff with Tonga in the backfield gains a first down. Fragmented commentary may span multiple carries.
Makes a spinning catch on a quick throw; Rylie Moss is mentioned immediately afterward.
Runs for 12 yards and a first down.
Escapes pressure, breaks a tackle and scrambles up the middle for a touchdown.
Catches a first-down bullet from Nix.
Converts third-and-five with a reception against a four-man rush.
Motions before making his third catch of the possession.
Catches a 19-yard touchdown to the left. Waddle releases from the backfield to the flat, occupying the corner and opening space behind him.
plays.concept: flat route creating space for a deeper receiver

plays.description: Takes a handoff for a pickup; exact gain is not stated.
Third-and-seven throw toward Xavier Worthy is nearly intercepted by McMillan.
Catches a pass behind him as Nix rolls left off play-action; commentary questions the favorable spot.
Runs for 6 yards and a first down; Nick Bolton makes the tackle.
Catches a screen with blockers ahead but is stopped short, bringing up fourth down. Tranquill is involved in the stop.
Starts left, bends the run back and gains 9 yards. DJ Jones and Uwazurike miss tackles.
Pass intended for Cyrus Allen is tipped and falls short, bringing up fourth down.
Takes a handoff for 5 yards on the edge; Bolton brings him down.
Makes a backfield reception, stays on his feet through a missed tackle by Sneed and gains 4 yards.
plays.concept: pass to back out of backfield

plays.description: Moves right looking for a receiver on third-and-a-long-one; sequence ends with fourth down. Exact result is unclear.
Catches a pass after a bad snap and dives for a first down.
Breaks tackles on a left-end run for 28 yards to the Denver 41.
Catches a pass over the middle and is stopped at the marker by McMillan.
Turns a short right reception into a 13-yard touchdown. Moss misses the tackle; commentary also describes Jonah Ellis failing to wrap up.
Pulls the ball down and is sacked by rookie R. Mason Thomas.
Makes a strong catch; subsequent commentary says Denver hurries.
Backpedals against extra rushers and throws incomplete, bringing up fourth down. A defender's name is unclear in the captions.
Quick reception is stopped a yard short of the first down by Rylie Moss.
Converts fourth-and-one and continues for a 60-yard touchdown around left end.
Finds room for 3 yards on second-and-six; Karlaftis makes the tackle.
plays.personnel_formation: Dobbins stays in; Harvey checks out

plays.description: Cannot hold onto a third-down pass. Commentary discusses Spagnuolo disguising pressure.
After a run fake, throws deep middle toward Worthy and is intercepted by Brandon Jones, who returns it 24 yards to the KC 5. Commentary says Worthy was unaware the ball was coming.
plays.coverage_scheme: Middle safety described; full coverage unknown

plays.description: Completes a pass down to the 10 following mention of a penalty; receiver and gain are unstated.
Moves right and back left, then loses the ball while preparing to throw. Sneed touches it while out of bounds; officials rule a fumble retained by Denver at that spot.
Handles a bad snap on third-and-goal from outside the 16 and throws unsuccessfully toward Waddle, who cannot separate from Christian Fulton.
Makes a 31-yard field goal after Denver fails to convert first-and-goal from the 5 into a touchdown.
Catches a short left pass against a blitz and gains 59 yards to the Denver 4. Replay commentary credits his patience selling the route against one-on-one coverage.
plays.coverage_scheme: Blitz with one-on-one coverage on Kelce
plays.defender_beaten: J. Barron (DB tackler; initial coverage assignment unknown)

plays.description: Is tripped up and sacked on third-and-goal; commentary says Kelce was open in the end zone.
Makes a 28-yard field goal.
Catches a play-action pass, breaks Noel Williams' tackle and gains a first down.
Is identified as the ball carrier or target, but the caption cuts away before establishing the play's action or result.
Is strip-sacked by Felix Anudike-Uzomah; Chris Jones recovers. Commentary says Kansas City showed blitz and backed out, while Denver linemen moved downfield on a dropback pass.
plays.coverage_scheme: Showed blitz, then backed out; full coverage unknown

plays.description: Catches a pass in stride and is tackled by McMillan, bringing up third down.
Converts third-and-five with a short left reception, breaks a tackle and gains 25 yards to the Denver 4. A subsequent unnecessary-roughness penalty moves the ball 2 yards closer.
plays.defender_beaten: J. Barron (DB tackler; missed tackler unidentified)

plays.description: Scores on a 2-yard forward toss, officially a touchdown pass from Mahomes. Commentary states Fields is in the game without specifying his role.
plays.personnel_formation: Fields in the game; alignment unknown

plays.description: Makes his second catch and is tackled immediately by Kristian Fulton.
Is flushed on third-and-five and throws into the ground while chased by Bolton and Chris Jones.
Bends a run back on second-and-nine and adds to his rushing total.
Breaks tackles on a run and is eventually brought down downfield. Malcolm Roach is named in a fragmented discussion of the tackle and a missed tackle.
Is sacked by Zach Allen, Denver's second sack of the night.
A brief call identifies Harvey, but does not establish the action or outcome.
Makes a catch for a first down.
Fails to secure the snap and the ball hits the ground; recovery is not stated.
Catches a short pass that results in Kansas City's ninth consecutive third-down stop.
Escapes pressure on fourth-and-eight and throws across his body toward Troy Franklin. Noel Williams breaks up the pass.
Takes a third-down carry; commentary praises his effort and mentions Khalil Benson, but does not clearly state the gain or conversion.

offense_strengths: Pat Bryant made three catches on the touchdown possession, including a third-and-five conversion.
Engram scored against zone behind Waddle's flat route and added catches on play-action, including a first down after a broken tackle.
Harvey supplied a 6-yard first-down run and a 4-yard backfield reception through a missed tackle.
defense_weaknesses: Walker repeatedly gained yards after missed tackles, including a 9-yard cutback, a 28-yard left-end run and a 60-yard touchdown.
Moss and Ellis failed to finish tackles on Rice's 13-yard touchdown reception.
A blitz left Kelce one-on-one on his 59-yard reception.
Johnson added a 25-yard reception through a broken tackle and a later run through multiple tackle attempts.

offense_strengths: Walker produced sustained rushing gains, with left-side runs and cutbacks repeatedly highlighted; he scored on a 60-yard run and a 2-yard forward toss.
Mahomes escaped pressure for a 15-yard rushing touchdown.
Short completions generated major gains: Rice's 13-yard touchdown, Kelce's 59-yard reception and Johnson's 25-yard reception.
Johnson supplied additional rushing gains and broken tackles.
defense_weaknesses: Denver exploited zone coverage for Engram's touchdown by occupying the corner with Waddle's flat route.
Bryant caught three passes on Denver's touchdown drive, including a third-down conversion.
Sneed missed Harvey on a backfield reception, and Noel Williams missed Engram on a play-action first down.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were reviewed. Many plays lack gains, identities, outcomes or complete context. NO DB MATCH means no clear match in the supplied selective DB excerpt, not that the play is absent from the full database. Replay descriptions are merged with their original plays. Fragmentary calls are retained with uncertainty. Names without a clear DB match remain as captioned or are identified as uncertain. Personnel and coverage details are included only when explicitly stated by commentators; DB shotgun labels were not used for personnel_formation. Named tacklers are labeled as tacklers and do not imply they were beaten in coverage. Interception yards are return yards; field-goal yards are kick distances. For the strip-sack, yards is the stated 9-yard sack loss, while the DB event's recovery-yardage field is 0. DB kickoff returns were not added without identifiable caption descriptions. Extra points are not separately identifiable in the captions. No exact run gaps, full coverage calls, route combinations or blocking assignments can be established beyond the supplied commentary and DB text.
